name: Nick Nowak
headline: A pharmacist who builds things: companies, networks and care models at the edges of what healthcare is willing to try.
bio: Nick is a pharmacist (PharmD, BCPS) whose career runs from emergency medicine and ICU high-dose ketamine to running 503A compounding pharmacy operations. He co-founded Meeko Health, which credentialed more than 100 clinics into a national psychedelic therapy network and brought ketamine and TMS care to employers. He founded Mind Shift Collective and serves on the board of Pearl Institute in Western North Carolina.
helpWith: Compounding regulation, payer and TPA infrastructure, building clinic networks, and pharmaceutical commercialization.
